answer_1.quote: We evaluate memorization on four reasoning tasks of varying complexity: Applied Math, Formula Calculation, Counting, and Capitalization. All tasks require step-by-step reasoning under a Chain-of-thought prompting setup...

answer_2.quote: We assess the effectiveness of STIM in pinpointing erroneous tokens via Precision@k and Recall@k, showing that high memorization scores are strong indicators of reasoning failures.

answer_3.quote: For each example that the model answers wrongly, we use gpt4-o to identify the wrong tokens in the erroneous reasoning step identified by VersaPRM described in Section 4.
